outcome: receipt of clinic-based postpartum care (PPC) visit
cohort: The study included 14,531 individuals who gave birth in a large referral hospital in the Southern US between January 2014 and March 2020.
finding: Having private insurance, compared to Medicaid, was associated with a higher likelihood of receiving clinic-based postpartum care, with disparities modestly influenced by the interaction between race and insurance type.
